verdict.rationale: Rippling's benefits docs describe administering coverage: reopening enrollment in one click, comparing plans, submitting qualifying life events, and approving dependents. They also say carrier EOI uploads update coverage and adjust payroll deductions in bulk, and that benefits deductions flow automatically into Payroll. Missing for 10: explicit mention of offering health/medical insurance plans or carrier connections (coverage is described generically), any detail on how enrollment is set up and administered, and independent or hands-on corroboration that deductions sync to payroll.
